title: Artisan Translations
description: The translations of a workspace: one key per translatable text, referenced from menus and commands as {i18n:<key>}. Each translation is MiniMessage (https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/).

schema.description: Schema version. Fixed, so that migrations can apply on load.

default_lang.description: The workspace's reference language. Every key has it; it is the last fallback.

languages.description: The workspace's languages, including default_lang. A listed language missing a key falls back to default_lang (with a warning in the editor).

^[a-z]{2,3}(?:_[A-Za-z]{2,4})?$.description: The key's text in this language, in MiniMessage. May contain PlaceholderAPI placeholders (%player_name%) and other {i18n:other.key} references.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\\.[a-z0-9_]+)*$.description: Language → text for this key. Contains at least default_lang.

keys.description: Every key of the workspace with its translations. Keys are dotted slugs (e.g. menu.shop_main.btn_buy.title).

metadata.description: Computed metadata. Not edited by hand.

LangCode.description: A language code (ISO 639-1/3) with an optional region: fr, en, en_US, pt_BR, zh_CN, fil. Lowercase language, optional underscore and region.
